Affix a recent passport size colour photograph with self-attestation across the photograph.

important_instructions: Applications received after the due date shall not be considered and incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected. Fifteen (15) Candidates Shortlisted on Merit basis will be called for Certificate Verification and Interview.

content_sections.heading: BBMCH Laboratory Technician Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Laboratory Technician post under the Multi-Disciplinary Research Unit (MRU).

content_sections.heading: BBMCH Laboratory Technician Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. * Candidate with 1 year of Lab experience in a recognized institute after completion of DMLT shall be preferred. Candidates with work experience in Molecular Biology and Quality assured Laboratory shall be preferred. Must possess requisite qualification. Applicants who have passed (HSC/Equivalent, +2/Equivalent, DMLT/ B.Sc (MLT)/ M.Sc (MLT)) in more than one attempt will not be considered. Must be of good mental condition and bodily health and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with the discharge of his/her duty. If married, must not have more than one spouse living. Candidate must have a valid Registration Certificate from the State Council of DMLT/DMRT, Odisha.

rows.qualification_required: 10+2 with Science subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology) and B.Sc (Medical Laboratory Technology) OR 10+2 with Science Subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology) and 2 years Diploma (DMLT from AICTE approved institute)*

content_sections.heading: BBMCH Laboratory Technician Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates with essential qualifications will be short-listed and called for interview on the basis of career marks. Final merit list will be done on the basis of career mark weightage and Viva-voce test mark.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBMCH Laboratory Technician
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website bbmchbalangir.odisha.gov.in . Fill up the application form in the given format. Affix a recent passport size colour photograph with self-attestation across the photograph. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant original documents and certificates. Send the filled application form by Speed post or Registered post only to the Office of the Dean and Principal, Bhima Bhoi Medical College & Hospital, Balangir, PIN-767002, Odisha. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 28.10.2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: HSC / Equivalent certificate and marksheet +2 / Equivalent certificate and marksheet Diploma / Degree certificate and marksheets Valid Registration Certificate from the State Council of DMLT/DMRT, Odisha Experience certificate (if applicable) Caste/Category certificate for age relaxation (if applicable) Passport size colour photograph

content_sections.heading: BBMCH Laboratory Technician Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date shall not be considered and incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected. The office will not be responsible for any postal delay in receiving the application form. Application received incomplete or received through any other mode other than speed post/Registered post are liable to be summarily rejected. The candidate will be appointed purely on contractual basis for a period of 364 days, which may be curtailed or extended further subject to satisfactory performance or funds available for the project. The appointment is purely on temporary basis and the incumbent candidate will have no claim for regularization of his/her services. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidate for appearing in the interview. Publication of Name of short listed candidate and other important information will be uploaded in the website from time to time. Fifteen (15) Candidates Shortlisted on Merit basis will be called for Certificate Verification and Interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is BBMCH Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an offline recruitment notification issued by Bhima Bhoi Medical College and Hospital Balangir to hire 1 Laboratory Technician on a contractual basis for the Multi-Disciplinary Research Unit (MRU).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for BBMCH Laboratory Technician?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Laboratory Technician post under the UR category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form by Speed post or Registered post is 28 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 10+2 with Science subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology) and B.Sc (Medical Laboratory Technology) or a 2 years Diploma (DMLT) from an AICTE approved institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BBMCH Laboratory Technician?
faq.answer: The candidate should be between 21 years and 38 years of age as on the date of advertisement, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per Odisha government rules.
